notes: §1985:XIII.4.5.4 GR1 Table 1: OUTPUT 'Normal open; the file contains no records' or 'Open causes the file to be created'; EXTEND 'Open is unsuccessful' when unavailable, and an optional file is created. SequentialConnector.OpenCore implements each cell (OUTPUT creates or truncates, EXTEND gives 35 for a missing non-optional file, 05 and creation for an optional one), and the 85 arm SharingFacilityInEffect=false in SharedOpenAttempt skips Table 19, so a file already open by another connector opens normally as 1985 Table 1 says. Probes at 85: OUTPUT of an existing two-line file leaves one line; EXTEND appends; non-optional EXTEND of a missing file gives 35 and creates nothing; two SELECTs on one file open OUTPUT and EXTEND with 00 (2023 gives 61); witness shows 00 and 05.

next.reason: Availability definition and the OUTPUT, EXTEND and optional EXTEND rows are kept (§2023:14.9.27.4 GR4 Table 18; creation per §2023:14.9.27.4 GR17 and §2023:14.9.27.4 GR18). But 2023 restricts Table 18 to files not currently open by another connector and adds Table 19, which 'shows the results of opening available files that are currently open by another file connector': OUTPUT then always unsuccessful, EXTEND sharing-dependent, with the default sharing mode implementor-defined (§2023:14.9.27.4 GR23). 1985 Table 1 says an available file always opens normally. Run-time only; no refusal.
